blinding_guess.why: B has a requirement-mapped test suite (load/validate/run/history/stdlib packaging) and documented exit codes, typical of a spec-driven process; A has more unrequested features and no tests.

notes: Probe definitions carry both 'final' (A) and 'finals' (B) keys so only the interface adapts. A records rejected events in history and continues; B stops at the first rejected event with exit 1 — both are reasonable readings of the task.
